content.json:
## Overview
Request volume, error rates and latency percentiles.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| summarize Total = count(),
            Failed = countif(tobool(success) == false),
            AvgMs = round(avg(duration), 1),
            P95Ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1)
| project Metric = 'Total Requests', Value = tostring(Total)
| union (
    requests
    | where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
    | summarize v = countif(tobool(success) == false)
    | project Metric = 'Failed Requests', Value = tostring(v)
)
| union (
    requests
    | where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
    | summarize v = round(avg(duration), 1)
    | project Metric = 'Avg Duration (ms)', Value = tostring(v)
)
| union (
    requests
    | where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
    | summarize v = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1)
    | project Metric = 'P95 Duration (ms)', Value = tostring(v)
)
content.title: Request Summary

content.query:
let bin_ = {TimeRange:grain};
requests
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| summarize Requests = count(), Errors = countif(tobool(success) == false)
    by bin(timestamp, bin_)
| render timechart
content.title: Request Rate Over Time

content.query:
let bin_ = {TimeRange:grain};
requests
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| summarize P50 = percentile(duration, 50),
            P90 = percentile(duration, 90),
            P99 = percentile(duration, 99)
    by bin(timestamp, bin_)
| render timechart
content.title: Latency Percentiles Over Time

content.json:
## Tools
MCP tool call distribution, latency and error rates.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name']))
| summarize Calls = count()
    by Tool = tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name'])
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Tool Call Distribution

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name']))
| summarize Calls = count(),
            ['Avg (ms)'] = round(avg(duration), 1),
            ['P50 (ms)'] = round(percentile(duration, 50), 1),
            ['P95 (ms)'] = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1),
            Errors = countif(tobool(success) == false)
    by Tool = tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name'])
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Tool Latency

content.query:
let bin_ = {TimeRange:grain};
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name']))
| summarize Total = count(), Errors = countif(tobool(success) == false)
    by bin(timestamp, bin_),
       Tool = tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name'])
| extend ['Error %'] = round(100.0 * Errors / Total, 1)
| project timestamp, Tool, ['Error %']
| render timechart
content.title: Tool Error Rate Over Time

content.json:
## Data Volume
Request counts by tool and blob payload sizes.

content.query:
let bin_ = {TimeRange:grain};
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name']))
| summarize Calls = count()
    by bin(timestamp, bin_),
       Tool = tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name'])
| render timechart
content.title: Request Counts by Tool and Period

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name']) startswith 'blob-'
| extend PayloadBytes = tolong(tostring(customDimensions['blob.content_length']))
| where PayloadBytes > 0
| summarize ['Total MB'] = round(sum(PayloadBytes) / 1048576.0, 2),
            ['Avg KB'] = round(avg(PayloadBytes) / 1024.0, 1),
            ['Max KB'] = round(max(PayloadBytes) / 1024.0, 1),
            Operations = count()
    by Tool = tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name'])
| order by ['Total MB'] desc
content.title: Blob Payload Sizes

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where tostring(customDimensions['mcp.tool.name']) startswith 'blob-'
| extend PayloadBytes = tolong(tostring(customDimensions['blob.content_length']))
| where PayloadBytes > 0
| summarize ['Total MB'] = round(sum(PayloadBytes) / 1048576.0, 2),
            Operations = count()
    by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Daily Data Transfer

content.json:
## Logs
Log severity distribution and recent warning/error log entries.

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| extend Severity = case(
    severityLevel == 1, 'INFO',
    severityLevel == 2, 'WARN',
    severityLevel == 3, 'ERROR',
    severityLevel == 4, 'FATAL',
    'DEBUG')
| summarize Count = count() by Severity
| render piechart
content.title: Log Severity Distribution

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s)
| where severityLevel >= 2
| project timestamp,
         Severity = case(
             severityLevel == 1, 'INFO',
             severityLevel == 2, 'WARN',
             severityLevel == 3, 'ERROR',
             severityLevel == 4, 'FATAL',
             'OTHER'),
         Message = message,
         ['Trace ID'] = operation_Id,
         Service = cloud_RoleName
| order by timestamp desc
| take 100
content.title: Recent Logs (WARN and above)
